name.description: The name of the PolarDBX instance.

i18n.zh-Hans: PolarDBX 实例的名称。
i18n.en-US: The name of the PolarDB-X instance.

instance_id.description: The ID of an existing PolarDBX instance. If set, no new instance will be created.

i18n.zh-Hans: 现有PolarDB-X实例的ID。如果设置该参数，则不会创建新实例。
i18n.en-US: The ID of an existing PolarDB-X instance. If specified, no new instance will be created.

engine_version.description: The database engine version. Valid values: 5.7, 8.0.

i18n.zh-Hans: 数据库引擎版本。有效值：5.7、8.0。
i18n.en-US: The database engine version. Valid values: 5.7, 8.0.

storage.description: The storage size of the instance in GB.

i18n.zh-Hans: 实例的存储大小（单位：GB）
i18n.en-US: The storage size of the instance in GB.

vswitch_id.description: The ID of the VSwitch for network configuration.

i18n.zh-Hans: 用于网络配置的交换机ID。
i18n.en-US: The ID of the VSwitch used for network configuration.

i18n.zh-Hans: 计算节点（CN）类
i18n.en-US: The class of computing nodes (CN).

i18n.zh-Hans: 计算节点（CN）的数量
i18n.en-US: The number of computing nodes (CN).

i18n.zh-Hans: 存储节点（DN）的类别
i18n.en-US: The class of storage nodes (DN).

i18n.zh-Hans: 存储节点（DN）的数量
i18n.en-US: The number of storage nodes (DN).

i18n.zh-Hans: 拓扑类型。有效值：1azone、3azones。
i18n.en-US: The topology type. Valid values: 1azone, 3azones.

description.description: The description of the PolarDBX instance.

i18n.zh-Hans: PolarDB-X 实例的描述。
i18n.en-US: The description of the PolarDB-X instance.

databases.description: Map of databases to create. Key is database name, value is database configuration.

i18n.zh-Hans: 要创建的数据库映射表。键为数据库名称，值为数据库配置。
i18n.en-US: Map of databases to create. The key is the database name, and the value is the database configuration.

accounts.description: Map of accounts to create. Key is account name, value is account configuration.

i18n.zh-Hans: 要创建的账户映射表。键为账户名称，值为账户配置。
i18n.en-US: Map of accounts to create. Key is account name, value is account configuration.

use_account_database_binding.description: Whether to use alibabacloudstack_polardbx_account_database_binding resource for account privileges.

i18n.zh-Hans: 是否使用 alibabacloudstack_polardbx_account_database_binding 资源来管理账号权限。
i18n.en-US: Whether to use the alibabacloudstack_polardbx_account_database_binding resource for account privileges.

super_account.description: Super account configuration for the PolarDBX instance. Set to null to skip creating the super account. The security account group (name/password) and the audit account group (name/password) must be provided together - either both or neither.
super_account.type:
object({
    admin_account_name           = string
    admin_account_password       = string
    admin_account_description    = optional(string, "")
    security_account_name        = optional(string)
    security_account_password    = optional(string)
    security_account_description = optional(string, "")
    audit_account_name           = optional(string)
    audit_account_password       = optional(string)
    audit_account_description    = optional(string)
  })

i18n.zh-Hans: PolarDB-X 实例的高权限账号配置。设为 null 则跳过高权限账号的创建。安全账号组（名称/密码）与审计账号组（名称/密码）必须同时提供——要么都配置，要么都不配置。
i18n.en-US: Super account configuration for the PolarDB-X instance. Set to null to skip creating the super account. The security account group (name/password) and the audit account group (name/password) must be provided together - either both or neither.

enable_log_engine.description: Whether to enable log engine (CDC) configuration.

i18n.zh-Hans: 是否启用日志引擎（CDC）配置。
i18n.en-US: Whether to enable the log engine (CDC) configuration.

log_engine_cdc_node_class.description: The specification for log engine (CDC) nodes.

i18n.zh-Hans: 日志引擎（CDC）节点的规范。
i18n.en-US: The specification for log engine (CDC) nodes.

log_engine_cdc_node_count.description: The number of log engine (CDC) nodes.

i18n.zh-Hans: 日志引擎（CDC）节点数量。
i18n.en-US: The number of log engine (CDC) nodes.

log_engine_multi_streams.description: List of multi-stream configurations for CDC.
log_engine_multi_streams.type:
list(object({
    group_name = string
    comment    = optional(string, "")
    hash_level = string
    node_class = string
    node_count = number
  }))

i18n.zh-Hans: CDC 多流配置列表
i18n.en-US: List of multi-stream configurations for CDC.

enable_read_write_splitting.description: Whether to enable read-write splitting configuration.

i18n.zh-Hans: 是否启用读写分离配置。
i18n.en-US: Whether to enable read-write splitting configuration.

rw_splitting_attend_htap_list.description: List of HTAP instances to attend.

i18n.zh-Hans: 要参加的HTAP实例列表
i18n.en-US: List of HTAP instances to attend.

rw_splitting_auto_attend_htap.description: Whether to automatically attend HTAP instances.

i18n.zh-Hans: 是否自动加入HTAP实例。
i18n.en-US: Whether to automatically attend HTAP instances.

rw_splitting_delay_execution_strategy.description: Delay execution strategy. Valid values are 0 and 1.

i18n.zh-Hans: 延迟执行策略。有效值为 0 和 1。
i18n.en-US: Delay execution strategy. Valid values are 0 and 1.

rw_splitting_enable_consistent_replica_r.description: Whether to enable consistent replica read.

i18n.zh-Hans: 是否启用一致性副本读取。
i18n.en-US: Whether to enable consistent replica reads.

i18n.zh-Hans: 是否启用 HTAP。
i18n.en-US: Whether to enable HTAP.

rw_splitting_master_read_weight.description: The read weight of the master instance. Valid values are 1 to 100.

i18n.zh-Hans: 主实例的读取权重，取值范围为1到100。
i18n.en-US: The read weight of the master instance. Valid values are 1 to 100.

rw_splitting_storage_delay_threshold.description: The storage delay threshold for read-write splitting.

i18n.zh-Hans: 读写分离的存储延迟阈值
i18n.en-US: The storage delay threshold for read-write splitting.

enable_readonly_instance.description: Whether to create a read-only instance for the PolarDBX primary instance.

i18n.zh-Hans: 是否为PolarDBX主实例创建只读实例。
i18n.en-US: Whether to create a read-only instance for the PolarDB-X primary instance.

readonly_instance_name.description: The name of the read-only PolarDBX instance.

i18n.zh-Hans: 只读PolarDBX实例的名称。
i18n.en-US: The name of the read-only PolarDB-X instance.

readonly_storage.description: The storage size of the read-only instance in GB.

i18n.zh-Hans: 只读实例的存储空间大小（单位：GB）
i18n.en-US: The storage size of the read-only instance, in GB.

readonly_cn_node_count.description: The number of computing nodes (CN) for the read-only instance.

i18n.zh-Hans: 只读实例的计算节点（CN）数量。
i18n.en-US: The number of computing nodes (CN) for the read-only instance.

readonly_dn_node_count.description: The number of storage nodes (DN) for the read-only instance.

i18n.zh-Hans: 只读实例的存储节点（DN）数量。
i18n.en-US: The number of storage nodes (DN) for the read-only instance.

readonly_cn_node_class.description: The class of computing nodes (CN) for the read-only instance.

i18n.zh-Hans: 只读实例的计算节点（CN）类别。
i18n.en-US: The class of computing nodes (CN) for the read-only instance.

readonly_dn_node_class.description: The class of storage nodes (DN) for the read-only instance.

i18n.zh-Hans: 只读实例的存储节点（DN）类别。
i18n.en-US: The class of storage nodes (DN) for the read-only instance.

readonly_description.description: The description of the read-only PolarDBX instance.

i18n.zh-Hans: 只读PolarDBX实例的描述。
i18n.en-US: The description of the read-only PolarDB-X instance.
